title: The Weight of the Crown
logline: A young king, burdened by his royal duties, finds true wisdom and purpose by observing the simple lives of his people.

characters.name: King Arthur
characters.one_line_description: A young, thoughtful monarch grappling with the immense responsibilities of his crown.

scenes.title: The Burdened Throne
scenes.summary: King Arthur sits alone on his grand throne, looking pensive and overwhelmed by the weight of his royal duties.
scenes.setting: A vast, opulent throne room, dimly lit, emphasizing isolation.

scenes.title: A Glimpse of Daily Life
scenes.summary: King Arthur, disguised in simple clothes, walks through a bustling village market, observing his people's daily struggles and moments of joy.
scenes.setting: A vibrant, crowded medieval market square, full of life.

scenes.title: An Act of Connection
scenes.summary: King Arthur discreetly helps an old woman struggling with a heavy basket, feeling a direct connection to his people and their immediate needs.
scenes.setting: A narrow, cobblestone village street near the market.

scenes.title: The True Purpose
scenes.summary: Back on his throne, King Arthur now wears a serene and determined expression, understanding that true leadership lies in serving his people.
scenes.setting: The same throne room, now brighter and feeling more purposeful.
